🐶❤️ HELP US GIVE BACK TO SHIH TZUS IN NEED! ❤️🐾

Our NYC Shih Tzu Meetup is more than just hundreds of adorable Shih Tzus coming together — it’s also an opportunity to help Shih Tzus who need us. 🐾

This year, we’re asking our amazing Shih Tzu family to consider making a donation to Lone Star Shih Tzu and Lhasa Apso Rescue. Every donation, no matter the amount, helps provide care and a second chance to Shih Tzus in need. ❤️

🎟️ WANT TO DONATE? IT’S SUPER EASY!

👉 CLICK THE LINK IN OUR BIO
👉 Click on Mason’s photo
👉 You’ll be directed to the “Get Tickets” page
👉 Enter whatever donation amount you’d like to contribute

Every little bit helps, and together we can make a difference! 🐾❤️ EVERY penny goes toward the Shih Tzus.

Thank you for helping us support Shih Tzus in need and for being part of our amazing NYC Shih Tzu family. 🥰

Together, we can make a difference — one Shih Tzu at a time. 🐶❤️
